headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty fell on inflation concerns, despite logging a third straight weekly gain

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on market sentiment during the last session
Global volatility following Nvidia's 13% weekly crash and CEO Jensen Huang's exit
Profit booking after the indices recorded a three-week winning streak
Weak opening signals from Gift Nifty earlier in the day
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty ended lower on Friday, with the Nifty50 slipping below the 25,150 mark
Indian markets successfully extended their gains for a third consecutive week
PSU Banks emerged as the top sectoral gainers for the week
India remains on track to achieve a $1 trillion export target this fiscal year
summary: On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty closed lower as inflation concerns and global volatility weighed on investor sentiment. Despite the Friday decline, Indian markets secured a third straight weekly gain, with PSU banks leading the sectoral rally. Market participants also noted that India remains on track to achieve its $1 trillion export target.
